verdict.rationale: The evidence shows practice-area service descriptions and a Lowenstein x Clerky partnership page with a pricing FAQ. None of it documents a public knowledge base of plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, or equity. The Clerky FAQ covers pricing for a formation product rather than educational content, so it counts only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages
